name: fast-gliner-compaction
description: Removal-first compaction for Claude Code sessions: tool calls whose information is in the workspace or superseded are removed, run outcomes are trimmed, research is kept; a self-hosted GLiNER2.5 classifier judges the rest.

serverUrl.title: Decision server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the fast-gliner-compaction server (local or a GPU host). Leave unset to use FGC_SERVER_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8765.

serverToken.title: Decision server token
serverToken.description: Bearer token matching the server's FGC_TOKEN. Leave unset to use FGC_TOKEN from the environment.

model.title: Decision model
model.description: Model asked about tool calls the rules cannot place: gliner-decide-1b (default), gliner-decide, gliner25-base, gliner25-multi, laya, ... The server loads it on first use unless FGC_LAZY=0.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum model probability that an unplaced output is still useful for it to be kept whole; below it the output is trimmed. Higher removes more.

removeTools.title: Always remove
removeTools.description: Comma-separated tool-name globs (e.g. mcp__db__*) whose calls are always removed. Wins over the built-in rules.

keepTools.title: Always keep
keepTools.description: Comma-separated tool-name globs whose calls are always kept. Wins over the rules and Always remove.

breadcrumbs.title: Leave a trace of removed calls
breadcrumbs.description: Replace each run of removed calls with one line naming the tools and files involved.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum character reduction required to replace history; below it the built-in summary runs instead.

trimHeadChars.title: Trimmed result head
trimHeadChars.description: Characters kept from the start of a trimmed result.

trimTailChars.title: Trimmed result tail
trimTailChars.description: Characters kept from the end of a trimmed result (where test and build summaries usually are).

trimInputChars.title: Trimmed input fields
trimInputChars.description: Characters kept of each long string input field (e.g. an inline script) of a trimmed call.

focusResultChars.title: Output shown to the model
focusResultChars.description: Characters of a tool result shown to the model when judging usefulness.

maxRequestItems.title: Decisions per request
maxRequestItems.description: Tool calls scored per server request.
